name: The Last Dragonrider
subtitle: A dragon-riding pixel RPG
localizedDescription: Explore Emberfell with Corin and his dragon in this pixel-art adventure. The game is included in the app for offline single-player play, with persistent saves on your device. Existing Google cloud saves and story co-op are available online through the game's sign-in flow. Browser-local saves do not transfer automatically. For AltStore Classic on iPhone and iPad running iOS 15 or newer.
